visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man wearing a white t-shirt, a silver chain necklace, and a black beaded bracelet sits in a red upholstered chair. He looks down at his smartphone with a distressed, squinting facial expression, appearing to be in mock pain or stress. A large blue and white question mark graphic overlays the scene. The background consists of a plain white wall with stacked cardboard boxes on the left. (2) The scene shifts to a bright green and white graphic interface for a digital quiz. Large bold text reads '2025 社交檢定 LINEguage'. A series of multiple-choice questions (Q1-Q8) are listed with 'VOTE' buttons beside them. The animation is clean and professional, resembling a social media app interface. (3) A series of quick cuts shows different individuals reacting to their phones. A woman with short black hair and glasses wearing a lemon-printed t-shirt laughs while sitting in a room with a tall yellow pencil-shaped object. Another person wearing a black 'BOSTON' cap wipes their eyes with a tissue, appearing to laugh-cry. The man from the first phase is shown again, laughing while clutching his chest and looking at his phone. (4) The setting changes to a modern office environment with several employees sitting at desks with computers and monitors. A man in a green t-shirt with tattoos on his arm stands in an office hallway, holding up his phone to the camera. The screen displays a large green LINE app icon. He gestures towards the phone with his other hand while looking at the camera with a slight smile.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a male voice speaking in a highly exaggerated, high-pitched, and whining tone, mimicking distress and crying. There is no music. The speech is clear but intentionally melodramatic. (2) Suddenly, a bright and upbeat electronic BGM with a strong rhythmic pulse kicks in. A new male narrator voice enters with high energy, a professional broadcast-style delivery, and a fast speech rate. He speaks clearly about a 'social test.' (3) The energetic BGM continues as the narrator describes the rewards of the test. Background sound effects of a woman laughing and another person making exaggerated sobbing sounds are clearly mixed in for comedic effect. The BGM remains dominant in the background. (4) The narrator's tone shifts slightly to a humorous, observational style while discussing office life. A final digital sound effect (stinger) signals the end of the promotional segment, and the BGM fades out sharply with a final percussive hit.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote a new LINE social interaction test called 'LINEguage' by relating it to common stressful work scenarios and offering points as a reward for participation.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct presentation of the brand logo, product features (the quiz), and specific reward information.
